design.name: 火浣鼠
design.brief: A mythical fire rat (火鼠) whose fur is woven into fireproof cloth in Chinese legend: a round, chubby rat with a thick coat of bristling fur that burns at the tips with white-gold flames, small fierce glowing eyes, big front teeth, a long fiery tail, little paws with four toes. Shown both standing and curled into a rolling ball of fire. Cute and explosive.
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright on its short hind legs in a neutral A-pose, the chubby round body facing straight ahead, both front paws held a little away from the body, open and relaxed; mouth closed showing the two big front teeth; eyes glowing; the long tail extending straight backwards and slightly upwards behind the body (not curled, not over the head); ALL flames are drawn as OPAQUE solid sculpted flame-shaped fur tufts with crisp edges (stylized carved fur that looks like flames, orange-red with pale gold tips), NOT transparent fire, NO glow halo, NO sparks, NO smoke, NO particles; never a rolled-up ball
design.turnaround_digits: each front paw with four separate clawed fingers and each hind foot with four separate clawed toes, clearly countable; the whole tail, both ears and every flame tuft fully inside the frame.
